author: ItzAidan
body:
Hello,
I was wondering if we can bring a /pay into the Avicus lounge. So for instance if you and and your friend are in the Avicus lounge. Or lobby, you can do /pay xXSoccer4Life7Xx 200 credits. Because if you are giving your friend credits, you would have to buy the credit blaster go away from everyone and blast it at them. I'm just saying this should be on here so it wouldn't be such a hassle. 
Thanks!
